description: This file defines a debug-only activity 'DeepLinkTvActivity' that provides buttons to directly launch TV index or instructions activities, and handles deep linking to open instructions directly based on the URI scheme.

classes.name: DeepLinkTvActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity for debugging deep links related to TV index and instructions. Displays buttons for launching specific activities and handles URI-based deep linking logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI buttons for deep linking to index and instructions, and processes the intent data for deep linking.
